news.title: Vega Jewellers Limited to Report Q4, 2026 Results on May 13, 2026
news.body: Vega Jewellers Limited announced that they will report Q4, 2026 results on May 13, 2026

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 6 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 6 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Independent Non-Executive Director Srisailapu Varnika is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2024. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Vega Jewellers Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Jan 29, 2026
news.body: Vega Jewellers Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Jan 29, 2026

news.title: Vega Jewellers Limited announced a financing transaction
news.body: Vega Jewellers Limited announced a private placement to issue 500,000 shares on January 13, 2026. The transaction has been approved by shareholders.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 21%
news.body: After last week's 21% share price gain to ₹247, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 19.8x. Average trailing P/E is 19x in the Luxury industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 1,319% over the past year.

news.title: Vega Jewellers Limited announced that it has received INR 24.6775 million in funding
news.body: On January 3, 2026, Vega Jewellers Limited closed the transaction. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors.
